name: Kettlebell Halo
steps: Stand tall holding the bell upside down by the horns in front of your chest.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes so your rib cage and torso stay completely still.
Guide the bell past one ear, behind your head and past the other ear to return to your chest.
Continue circling smoothly in alternating directions or evenly in both directions for the target duration.
tips: Move the kettlebell around your head rather than bobbing your head around the kettlebell.
Keep your ribs tucked down and avoid arching your lower back as the bell passes behind your neck.
